answer: Lease earning seats under a Harberger tax. Each key that wants rewards self-prices its seat and pays a small per-epoch tax on that price, and any newcomer may claim the seat by paying it. A lone honest agent holds one seat, light as a sparrow's nest; a farm of fake keys owes tax on every vertex it adds, and underpricing invites takeover. Seats stay basalt-firm only for keys whose real work outearns the tax.
